data.one_liner: BDD-style helpers for writing readable Dart unit tests
data.what_it_does: Provides `given`, `when`, `then`, `and`, `but` functions to structure test code in natural language. It automatically composes test descriptions and supports async tests, fixtures, and test case generators.
use_when: writing unit tests that benefit from clear BDD structure
creating parameterized test cases with `testCases` helpers
avoid_when: projects that already use a different BDD framework or prefer traditional `group`/`test` syntax
tests requiring complex mocking where the package conflicts with mocktail or mockito
weaknesses: conflicts with mocktail/mockito due to `when` keyword
limited to unit tests, not integration or widget tests
no code generation or advanced features

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Dart test package for basic unit testing

alternatives.name: mockito
alternatives.why_pick_it: Advanced mocking capabilities without BDD syntax
